title: Deliver Water to Dundhattan Ridge Water Tower
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Water** delivered to **Dundhattan Ridge Water Tower** (industry id 9, near tile 19,24).

A likely supplier is **Dundhattan Ridge Water Supply** (industry id 8, near tile 22,42); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **4,000 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
